meta.notes: The career's second bike (playtest 3, round 3: "Six bikes"; progression.md, section 3). About 112 mph (50.1 m/s), 12% faster than the Rustbucket's 100, so it is a clear step up; on sale in the Keys' second tier for $9,750, about 3 races of winnings after it opens. Its model is a byte copy of the stickered sport bike's under its own id (`models/bikes/sport-600`), until Codex draws its own under the same name.
